name: Tarkin's Fang
description: Tarkin's Fang was a planet located in the Deep Core, near the Treskov system. It was the location of a secret Galactic Empire base. However, the Empire abandoned it at the end of the Galactic Civil War, sealing it up well stocked for use as a base should another war with the New Republic break out.
